entries.ba7d02950fc38a87: A business operating the recruitment agency service “MS Agent,” specializing in administrative department positions (accounting, finance, HR, general affairs, legal, corporate planning, etc.) and professionals such as lawyers, certified public accountants, and tax accountants. Consultants match job seekers and client companies through counseling of job seekers and hearing of client companies’ specialized recruitment needs, and receive a success fee from the hiring company once the hire is decided and the candidate joins. Recruitment agency revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥4,294 million.
